However, looking at the available actions, 'submit_clean' is the only non-penalized action that doesn't violate rules or escalate unnecessarily, as the claim is already in the system. I cannot bill the patient yet because the claim is pending. I cannot write off. I cannot appeal. The only logical 'no-op' or 'wait' isn't listed.
